Part B Script (to be read)
Invented texts. Three songs, each to read twice with 30 Second pause. 1 · News. To read with the rhythm of a news.
⁧اُفْتُتِحَ صَبَاحَ اليَوْمِ فِي مَدِينَةِ الإِسْكَنْدَرِيَّةِ مَرْكَزٌ جَدِيدٌ لِتَعْلِيمِ اللُّغَاتِ، يَضُمُّ عِشْرِينَ قَاعَةً لِلدِّرَاسَةِ⁩
⁧وَمَكْتَبَةً فِيهَا أَكْثَرُ مِنْ عَشَرَةِ آلَافِ كِتَابٍ. وَيُتَوَقَّعُ أَنْ يَسْتَقْبِلَ المَرْكَزُ نَحْوَ ثَلَاثَةِ آلَافِ طَالِبٍ فِي عَامِهِ⁩
⁧الأَوَّلِ. وَيُذْكَرُ أَنَّ المَشْرُوعَ مُوِّلَ بِالتَّعَاوُنِ مَعَ ثَلَاثِ جَامِعَاتٍ أَجْنَبِيَّةٍ.⁩
2 · Interview with an interpreter. To read with the rhythm of fuṣḥā Talked.
⁧مَعَنَا اليَوْمَ المُتَرْجِمَةُ الفَوْرِيَّةُ رِيم سَالِم. مَا أَصْعَبُ شَيْءٍ فِي عَمَلِكِ؟⁩ : ⁧المُذِيعُ⁩
⁧الأَرْقَامُ وَالأَسْمَاءُ، بِلَا شَكٍّ. الفِكْرَةُ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ تُعِيدَ صِيَاغَتَهَا بِطُرُقٍ كَثِيرَةٍ، أَمَّا الرَّقْمُ فَلَهُ صِيغَةٌ⁩ : ⁧رِيم⁩
⁧وَاحِدَةٌ صَحِيحَةٌ. وَإِذَا أَخْطَأْتَ فِيهِ، تَغَيَّرَ الخَبَرُ كُلُّهُ.⁩
⁧وَمَا نَصِيحَتُكِ لِمَنْ يَبْدَأُ؟⁩ : ⁧المُذِيعُ⁩
⁧أَنْ يَقْرَأَ كَثِيرًا فِي لُغَتِهِ الأُمِّ أَيْضًا. المُتَرْجِمُ الجَيِّدُ يَعْرِفُ لُغَتَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَعْرِفَ لُغَةَ الآخَرِينَ.⁩ : ⁧رِيم⁩
⁧المُتَرْجِمَةُ الفَوْرِيَّةُ⁩ The interpreter is the simultaneous interpreter. 3 · Egyptian podcasts (to be read to an Egyptian speaker).
⁧أهلًا بيكم في حلقة جديدة. النهارده عايز أحكيلكم عن أول مرة اشتغلت فيها مترجم. بص يا⁩
⁧إنت بتعرف⁩ : ⁧سيدي، كان فيه وفد إيطالي جاي يزور مصنع، والمترجم الأصلي كان عيان. قالولي⁩
⁧إيطالي، تعالى. أنا قلت: ماشي، سهلة. لأ وإيه، أول كلمة قالها المدير الإيطالي كانت كلمة فنية عمري⁩
⁧حسيت إنهم سنة. في الآخر قلتله بصراحة: معلش، الكلمة⁩ … ⁧ما سمعتها! وقفت ساكت عشر ثواني⁩
⁧دي يعني إيه؟ وشرحهالي، والدنيا مشيت. الفكرة إن المترجم الشاطر مش اللي بيعرف كل حاجة،⁩
⁧ده اللي بيعرف يسأل.⁩
wafd ...delegation. ʿayyān "Malato" · "kilma fanniyya" - "technical term" · sākit "In silence" "id-dunya" mišyit Everything went well.
A · Reading

1. A plan to hire 200 new interpreters in the courts in two years, after an official report Many processes are postponed due to lack of interpreters: they serve interpreters in over thirty languages (especially Arabic, English and Chinese), while the qualified interpreters are only one hundred twenty. The title contrasts the two positions with two expressions between quotes: the promise of the ministry ('a close solution') and the demand of translators ('recognization'). Italian title possible: . Courts without interpreters: the ministry promises "a solution shortly," translators ask "recognition" ...

2. Minister ( ⁧قال⁩ , neutral, with ḥāl ⁧مضيفا⁩ ): the plan will put an end to the hardships of thousands of people involved in processes; a national register of sworn interpreters will be established, with access only for examination. Union ( ⁧اعتبرت⁩ , an assessment; then ⁧أشار⁩ and the ḥāl ⁧مطالبا⁩ ): the plan does not address the cause of the problem, i.e. the low and late pay; an interpreter earns less than one cleaning officer per hour; calls for the interpreter to be recognised as a partner in the administration of justice. Professor ( ⁧رأت⁩ , an opinion): the solution is not only to increase the number, but also training; the interpreter in court translates rights, not words, and an error can change a person's destiny.

3. ⁧يُؤَجَّلُ⁩ : passive, because the processes do not postpone anything:             \ they are postponed. · ⁧نُشِرَ⁩ : passive, the ratio does not Public: Published last week. · ⁧لَا يُقْبَلُ⁩ : passive with ⁧إلا⁩ : "In which will be admitted only those who exceed..." · ⁧عُيِّنَ⁩ : passive, ⁧رئيس جديد⁩ as a subject (not ⁧عَيْن⁩ "Eye"): . · ⁧وَيُذْكَرُ⁩ : passive formula, it was remembered that it is.

4. It will put an end to the hardships of thousands of people involved in the trials (or thousands of citizens waiting for Judgment (s) () (ii) The interpreter in court does not translate words: he translates rights (the antithesis is preserved). ⁧تمّ⁩ + maṣdar → Italian passive or impersonal form: a national register will be established.

5. Last year the ministry had started an experiment of machine translation for some administrative documents, then interrupted after several errors. It is not yet clear whether the new plan plans to take it back. ⁧كانت قد بدأت⁩ It is a passing: it had started.
B · Listening

1. A new center for language teaching in Alexandria: twenty classrooms, a library with more ten thousand books; about three thousand students are expected in the first year; The project was funded with three foreign universities. Translation: "A new centre for language teaching was inaugurated this morning in Alexandria, with twenty classrooms and a library of more than ten thousand volumes.

2. Numbers and names: an idea can be reworded in many ways, a number has only one right form, and an error It changes the whole story. Tip: Read a lot in your native language too, because a good translator knows his language before that of others.

3. The first time he worked as an interpreter: an Italian delegation visited a factory and the interpreter Officer was sick. The first word of the Italian director was a technical term never heard; He remained silent ten seconds, then asked frankly what it meant, and everything went well. He learned that the good interpreter is not who knows everything, but who can ask questions. Signals: ⁧بص يا سيدي⁩ (keep your attention at the beginning of the story) · ⁧لأ وإيه⁩ (warns surprise) · ⁧في الآخر⁩ (conclusion) · ⁧الفكرة إن⁩ (the point, the morals).
C · Language

1. ⁧عُقِدَتِ القِمَّةُ فِي القَاهِرَةِ.⁩ The summit was held in Cairo. 2. ⁧وَقَّعَ عَدَدٌ مِنَ الكُتَّابِ عَلَى البَيَانِ⁩ . Several writers have signed the notice. 3. ⁧مُدِيرُ المُسْتَشْفَى الجَدِيدُ⁩ The new director of the hospital is: ⁧مُدِيرُ المُسْتَشْفَى الجَدِيدِ⁩ The Director of the new hospital is hereby appointed. · 4. ⁧بَلَدِيَّةُ رُومَا أَعْلَنَتْ⁩ ... (better: ⁧أَعْلَنَتْ بَلَدِيَّةُ رُومَا عَنْ مَشْرُوعٍ جَدِيدٍ⁩ ). ·
5. ⁧المَشَارِيعُ الجَدِيدَةُ سَتَبْدَأُ فِي الرَّبِيعِ.⁩ · 6. ⁧هٰذِهِ هِيَ المَدِينَةُ الَّتِي وُلِدْتُ فِيهَا.⁩ · 7. ⁧شَكَرَتِ الوَزِيرَةُ المُتَطَوِّعِينَ عَلَى⁩

⁧عَمَلِهِمْ.⁩ · 8. ⁧عُقِدَ المُؤْتَمَرُ فِي الجَامِعَةِ⁩ . ( ⁧أُقِيمَ⁩ · ⁧جَرَى⁩ ) · 9. The prices increase, the square boils down (or the square boils up after the increases). · 10. It seems that the rent will increase again, but no one is sure.
D · Translation · Example

The 20th International Book Fair is underway. The Minister of Culture inaugurated yesterday the twentieth edition of the International Book Fair, in which more than five hundred publishing houses from thirty countries participate. In his opening speech, the minister said that the fair "is no longer just a book market, but it has become a cultural event that readers wait for year after year," hoping that visitors will exceed the million. This year the fair dedicates a pavilion to translation, with meetings on the translation of Arabic literature into European languages and workshops for young translators. The management had already announced that the entrance will be free for students and children. Several publishers, however, criticized the cost of booths, claiming that small publishing houses "are no longer able to participate." The fair will remain open until the end of the month. • Points to check: the title with maṣdar made with an Italian expression ('Al via'), ⁧معربا عن أمله⁩ → • Wish it well; ⁧وكانت⁩ … ⁧قد أعلنت⁩ → passed; ⁧غير أن⁩ in the head → ⁧ارتفاع أسعار الأجنحة⁩ → The cost (the charge) of the stand (s); ⁧من المقرر أن يستمر⁩ → It will remain open (or it should remain open).
E · Translation to Arabic · Example
⁧قَدَّمَتْ بَلَدِيَّةُ مِيلَانُو أَمْسِ خُطَّةً لِتَسْهِيلِ الوُصُولِ إِلَى المَكْتَبَاتِ العَامَّةِ. وَاعْتِبَارًا مِنَ الشَّهْرِ المُقْبِلِ، سَتَبْقَى⁩
⁧اثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ مَكْتَبَةً مَفْتُوحَةً حَتَّى السَّاعَةِ العَاشِرَةِ لَيْلًا، وَثَلَاثٌ مِنْهَا يَوْمَ الأَحَدِ أَيْضًا. وَقَالَ المَسْؤُولُ عَنِ⁩
⁧، مُضِيفًا أَنَّ الخُطَّةَ سَتُكَلِّفُ مِلْيُونَيْ يُورُو. غَيْرَ أَنَّ⁩ « ⁧المَكْتَبَاتِ هِيَ سَاحَاتُ المُسْتَقْبَلِ⁩ » ⁧الثَّقَافَةِ فِي البَلَدِيَّةِ إِنَّ⁩
⁧وَيُتَوَقَّعُ أَنْ تَدْخُلَ⁩ .« ⁧لَا يَكْفِي⁩ » ⁧بَعْضَ أُمَنَاءِ المَكْتَبَاتِ طَالَبُوا بِتَوْظِيفِ عَامِلِينَ جُدُدٍ، لِأَنَّ عَدَدَ العَامِلِينَ الحَالِيَّ⁩
⁧الخُطَّةُ حَيِّزَ التَّنْفِيذِ فِي مَارِسَ.⁩

Version to be published: no vowels, except ⁧ويُتوقَّع⁩ (liability); Optional ⁧سَتُكلِّف⁩ and ⁧أُمَناء⁩ . Points to check: ⁧بلديةُ ميلانو⁩ without ⁧ال⁩ ; ⁧اثنتا عشرة مكتبة⁩ ( 12 with a female name to the singular accusative); ⁧ثلاثٌ منها⁩ ; ⁧مليونَيْ يورو⁩ (dual in iḍāfa, accusative); The Councillor shall be returned with ⁧المسؤول عن الثقافة في البلدية⁩ (the cast is avoided); ⁧بعض أمناء⁩ … ⁧طالبوا⁩ (subject before verb: plural); the quotation marks preserved.
F · Texts for the tutor
1 · Visible translation to Italian (to be delivered printed, without vowels):
⁧عين أمس مدير جديد للمتحف الوطني، بعد استقالة المدير السابق في الشهر الماضي. وقال المدير الجديد⁩
⁧، مشيرا إلى أن الدخول سيكون مجانيا كل يوم أحد اعتبارا من⁩ « ⁧فتح المتحف أمام الشباب⁩ » ⁧إن أولويته⁩
⁧الشهر المقبل. ويذكر أن المتحف يضم أكثر من مئة ألف قطعة أثرية.⁩

Waiting: ...A new director of the National Museum was appointed yesterday, after the resignation of the previous month. The new director said that his priority is "to open the museum to young people," stating that from next month admission will be free every Sunday. The museum has more than one hundred thousand exhibits.The words to explain: ⁧عُيِّن⁩ (taxable, subject ⁧مدير جديد⁩ ) · ⁧ويُذكَر⁩ (passive formula). 2 · View translation to Arabic (the tutor reads one sentence at a time):
a) The public is informed that the office will be closed on Friday. ⁧يُرْجَى العِلْمُ بِأَنَّ المَكْتَبَ سَيُغْلَقُ يَوْمَ الجُمُعَةِ.⁩
b) Thank you for understanding. → ⁧وَشُكْرًا لِتَفَهُّمِكُمْ.⁩
c) The Minister of Education announced a plan for schools. → ⁧أَعْلَنَ وَزِيرُ التَّعْلِيمِ عَنْ خُطَّةٍ لِلْمَدَارِسِ.⁩
d) The plan provides for the opening of ten new schools. ⁧وَتَشْمَلُ الخُطَّةُ فَتْحَ عَشْرِ مَدَارِسَ جَدِيدَةٍ.⁩
e) The trade unions, however, asked for more teachers. ⁧غَيْرَ أَنَّ النِّقَابَاتِ طَالَبَتْ بِمَزِيدٍ مِنَ المُعَلِّمِينَ.⁩
3 · Egyptian. Podcast track (to read at the natural rhythm):
⁧بص، الناس فاكرة إن الترجمة حاجة سهلة: تعرف لغتين وخلاص. لأ يا سيدي! الترجمة شغلانة⁩
⁧صعبة جدًا. خلينا نقول إنها زي الطبخ: ممكن يكون عندك نفس المكونات، بس الطعم يطلع مختلف⁩
⁧خالص. والمشكلة إن الناس ما بتاخدش بالها من الترجمة غير لما تكون وحشة. في الآخر، المترجم⁩
⁧الشاطر هو اللي محدش يحس بيه.⁩

Expected summary: Translation is not as easy as you think; it's like cooking: with the same ingredients the flavor can be very different; people only notice the translation when it's bad; The good translator is what you can't see.
